reason: A QQ Bot integration that exposes a message-sending tool and optionally drives agent sessions from inbound QQ messages over the QQ Bot WebSocket gateway.

summaries.zh: 通过 QQ Bot API 向用户或群组发送文本和 Markdown 消息，并可选地处理入站消息以驱动智能体会话。
summaries.en: Sends text and Markdown messages to QQ users or groups through the QQ Bot API and optionally drives agent sessions from inbound QQ messages.

capabilities: Sends text or Markdown messages to QQ users and groups through the QQ Bot API
Receives inbound QQ messages through a WebSocket gateway when enabled
Creates or drives agent sessions in response to inbound QQ messages
Uses configured QQ Bot AppID and AppSecret to authenticate with the QQ Bot service
